comparison.objective: Make a slicer safe and remove its carriage for cleaning; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Turn gauge control to zero, unwind a release knob, lift a carriage off rails, and place it safely versus recessed-key unlocking and feedback-guided collar tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Gauge plate closed before motion, carriage safely freed and placed without blade-zone entry versus two non-bottoming impact cycles with no overload or drift.
comparison.reason: Although both involve rotary controls and safety sequencing, the slicer task tests guarded disassembly rather than calibration; all five versions were read.
